authority: Owner correction after clarification of daily entry limit
daily_limit_semantics: null means no strategy-imposed daily entry cap; three or more entries are allowed when all other constraints permit
forced_flat_rule: schedule execution so the account is flat by session_close - 12h under declared execution availability; no new entry at or after that cutoff

early_close.objective: seek a beneficial executable close before compulsory liquidation when supported by the decision rule; compulsory liquidation remains the backstop

calendar_binding: Use the admitted versioned market calendar with timezone/DST, closures and actual execution availability; this contract does not invent timestamps
external_constraints: Broker/account restrictions remain separately enforced and identified; this is not a legal determination about PDT
deployment: No existing runtime or historical result changed by this design contract
